$comment: A neutral baseline containing ONLY fields this camera family actually accepts,
audited on hardware by writing each one and reading it back.
Deliberately absent because the firmware reports them but always discards writes:
image.led_brightness  - live measured IR level, not a setting
image.rotation        - only 0 is ever kept; use mirror + flip
There is no 'network' block: applying one camera's address to another would
collide. Addressing is set per camera on the Network tab.
day_begin / day_end are omitted too - they only matter with day_night_mode 3
(scheduled), and carrying one site's schedule to another is rarely what you want.
